name: Narrow window: one app at a time
author: wizard
description: When the AI apps desktop window is narrow (half or a third of the screen), it shows one app at a time: the app fills the window, the left Chats sidebar goes, and Chats becomes the first row of the right Apps column, set apart by a line. Chats at half width is the list beside the chat; narrower the list, then the chat with Back. Back from the list returns to the app you came from (wizard-ux issue 1314).
